# Final Project

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

This project uses YAML files to manage unique file paths and census API keys across users. To orient R to your unique file path and census API key, follow the steps below:

1. Create a file called `auth.yaml` in your local repository's home directory.

2. Open the file and paste the following text:

```{yaml}
# Path to my data
data_path: "C:/Users/your_user_name/your_folder/cdc_wonder_data_folder"

# My census api key
api: "MY_API_KEY"
```

Update the data path with your specific file path where the data are stored. Update the census API key with your specific key. You can request a census API key from the [U.S. Census Bureau](https://api.census.gov/data/key_signup.html).

3. Save the `auth.yaml` file after editing.
